walls.notes: Old Divinity School (Basil Champneys 1879), St John's Street front, north block. Red brick with Ketton-type stone dressings and quoin strips; gabled bay with a large pointed traceried two-light window over a band of carved heraldic shields (string course ~4.6 m), and a four-light stone-mullioned window at ground level. Only the southern ~6 m of this wall (next to the five-bay traceried range, walls :2-:18) is visible in the source photo; the northern part is not described. Gable apex rises above the wall height. Photo is from 2010 with hoarding in front.
